key_provisions_or_claims: No agricultural UAS operation without a CAAM-issued Aerial Work Certificate (private or commercial), plus notification to the nearest agricultural agency.
Operations limited to VLOS/EVLOS, below 400 ft AGL, at least 50 m from uninvolved persons, beyond 9.26 km from aerodromes, in Class G airspace only.
Autonomous operations (no remote pilot ability to intervene) are not allowed; remote pilots need RCoC credentials.
Operators must hold third-party liability insurance, run a safety management system and keep an operations manual and emergency response plan.
Only DOA-listed payloads and Pesticides Act-registered pesticides may be dispensed; mandatory occurrence reporting applies.
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian Civil Aviation Directive 6011 Part (II), issued by CAAM under the Civil Aviation Act 1969. It sets binding certification, operational, airworthiness, personnel, insurance and occurrence-reporting requirements for agricultural drone (UAS) operations, including pesticide dispensing. It also includes application forms, a pre-defined risk assessment and SMS guidance.
